secrets.name: AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY
secrets.description: Vercel AI Gateway API key for the AI model (anthropic/claude-haiku-4-5). Obtain from the Vercel AI Gateway dashboard. Falls back to VERCEL_OIDC_TOKEN if not set.

secrets.name: VERCEL_OIDC_TOKEN
secrets.description: Vercel OIDC token for Vercel Sandbox authentication. Obtain by running `vercel link` then `vercel env pull` in a linked Vercel project. Required for the agent's sandbox code execution.
